The file has no labels, so I read the 10 November instances and labelled them myself. That makes the answer a judgment call, not an exact count.

- **Neutral:** The anthuriums pair, and possibly "I know you are with me on this".

The labels I was unsure about don't change the result. Contradiction stays ahead of entailment either way.
